sections.heading: Student Services
sections.heading_path: Student Services
sections.text: While NYU-SPS has many resources unique to the school, the University also provides outstanding services. Here you will find an introduction to many of the important offices and staff that are available to assist you as a student.

sections.heading: Office of Student Affairs
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Office of Student Affairs
sections.text:
The Office of Student Affairs (OSA) strives to ensure student success by creating and supporting a diverse range of student-life activities, student governance, academic and conduct policies, academic enhancement through specially designed programs and workshops, and leadership programs and events. Serving as a liaison between the School's academic program areas and offices throughout the University, the OSA connects students to critical resources and services.

Students are encouraged to participate fully in School and University life - from club events to workshops and public dialogues - the opportunities are limitless. You will find supportive environments conducive to learning and to building enduring personal and professional relationships with the resources and encouragement you need to succeed.

sections.text: We have compiled many of our most popular resources, but this list is not exhaustive.

sections.heading: Academic Advising
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Academic Services > Academic Advising
sections.text:
Your advisor is your most important connection at the University. Advisors can either answer your questions directly or connect you with those who can.

Get to Know Your Advisor

sections.heading: Tutoring
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Academic Services > Tutoring
sections.text:
One-on-one tutoring can be the key to mastering material you find challenging or strengthening your skills in a particular subject area.

Learn More

sections.heading: Academic Enhancement Workshops
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Academic Services > Academic Enhancement Workshops
sections.text:
Take workshops in Excel and PowerPoint to round out your skills and enhance coursework presentations.

Workshops

sections.heading: NYU Library Services
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Academic Services > NYU Library Services
sections.text:
The NYU Elmer Holmes Bobst Library resources and services are comprehensive; from research-related assistance to the Digital Studio and much more, you will find unparalleled support for a successful academic experience.

Learn More

sections.heading: Study Abroad
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Academic Services > Study Abroad
sections.text:
NYU offers study away experiences in various locations around the globe. Take a summer or a semester to immerse yourself in the lifestyle of a culture that is new to you.

sections.heading: Moses Center for Accessibility
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Academic Services > Moses Center for Accessibility
sections.text:
NYU is committed to providing equal educational opportunities for students with disabilities. The Moses Center works with students to determine appropriate accommodations.

Learn More

sections.heading: University Learning Center
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Academic Services > University Learning Center
sections.text:
Academic tutors at the Learning Center are current NYU undergraduates who offer both one-on-one and group tutoring in a variety of courses.

Learn More

sections.heading: Student Services
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Student Services
sections.text: Student services are extensive at NYU. As you move through your academic career, you will find the support and resources you need at every turn. See below and get started.

sections.heading: Wasserman Center for Career Development
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Student Services > Wasserman Center for Career Development
sections.text:
The Wasserman Center for Career Development at NYUSPS guides students in the creation of customized career action plans to help them achieve their professional, career, and personal goals.

Learn More

sections.heading: Transportation
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Student Services > Transportation
sections.text:
Many options are available to get around New York City. Public transportation systems are extensive and run 24/7. University transportation services also run between the major academic building locations.

Learn More

sections.heading: IT Services
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Student Services > IT Services
sections.text:
NYU Information Technology (NYU IT) provides technology- based services and support for NYU students and all members of the University community.

Learn More

sections.heading: SPS Student Business Cards
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Student Services > SPS Student Business Cards
sections.text:
Students can order student business cards while studying at NYUSPS by completing the online application form. Once approved, your cards will be ready to be picked up in two to three weeks.

Complete the Application

sections.heading: Students in the Military and Veterans
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Student Services > Students in the Military and Veterans
sections.text:
NYU and SPS are committed to providing an environment for veterans to work toward achieving their academic and personal goals, and be involved in campus life.

Learn More

sections.heading: Safety, Health, and Wellness
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Safety, Health, and Wellness
sections.text: NYU is committed to safety, wellness education, and outstanding health care for all members of the University community. The Student Health Center offers routine and walk-in Primary Care and Women's Health Services at either no cost or very reduced cost to all matriculated students. Wellness, Short-term Counseling (talk therapy) and Crisis services are free of charge.

sections.heading: Wellness and Health Services
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Safety, Health, and Wellness > Wellness and Health Services
sections.text:
NYU provides extensive health and wellness services that address both physical and mental health concerns. From same-day appointments to mindfulness and relaxation techniques, the NYU Health Center can either take care of your needs directly or refer you to appropriate resources.

Learn More

sections.heading: Campus Safety
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Safety, Health, and Wellness > Campus Safety
sections.text:
The Department of Campus Safety is dedicated to preserving the safety and security of the NYU community. Assistance is available 24/7.

Learn More

sections.heading: Spiritual Life
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Safety, Health, and Wellness > Spiritual Life
sections.text:
The Office of Global Spiritual Life at NYU offers students the opportunity to engage in open and authentic conversations about religion and spirituality. Students share their experiences, connect with others, and participate in transformative, multi-faith encounters.

Learn More

sections.heading: Athletic Facilities
sections.heading_path: Student Services > Student Resources > Safety, Health, and Wellness > Athletic Facilities
sections.text:
NYU has three state-of-the-art athletic facilities – the Palladium and 404 Fitness in Greenwich Village and the Brooklyn Athletic Center on the Brooklyn campus. Students and athletes at NYU engage in sports and fitness in a variety of ways.

Learn More
